description:
Show where sessions first go wrong as an interactive transition matrix.

Rows are the last step that went right and columns the first step that went
wrong, counted over the sessions `filter` selects (for example an agent_id or
cohort_version_id). Pass `compare_filter`, such as a replay's
experiment_run_id, to compare two groups. A reviewer places a failure that
raised no error by annotating the failing node with the value
`{"first_failure": true, "note": "..."}`.

The result's snapshot_id lets a cell drill into exactly these sessions; it
is null on a server that keeps no matrix in memory.

FailureMatrixRequest.description:
Build a transition failure matrix over a group of sessions.

A failed session contributes one count to the cell (last step that went right,
first step that went wrong). A failed session is one whose status is failed,
that failed an evaluation, or that carries a first-failure annotation. The
failing step is the node a reviewer marked with a manual annotation whose
value is `{"first_failure": true, "note": "..."}` and whose selector names
the node, otherwise the deepest failed node.

compare_filter.description: Second session group to compare against, e.g. a replay's experiment_run_id.
compare_filter.title: Compare Filter

compare_label.description: Display name for the second group.
compare_label.title: Compare Label

filter.description: Session filter selecting the group, e.g. agent_id, cohort_version_id, experiment_run_id, or a started_at range.
filter.title: Filter

state_by.description: Which nodes count as states: tool and subagent calls, non-root spans, or both plus LLM calls.

description: Create or update provider connections and select provider defaults.

ConnectionCreate.description: Create a connection carrying provider environment and secret values.

env.description: Plain settings, stored unencrypted and readable by anyone who can read the connection. Keys that name credentials are refused: put those in `secrets`.
env.title: Env

idempotency_key.description: Pass a fresh unique string per logical request. Reuse it only when retrying this exact call after a lost or failed response, so the retry returns the original result instead of acting twice.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

ConnectionCreate.title: ConnectionCreate

ConnectionSetDefault.description: Make one connection the default for its provider.
ConnectionSetDefault.title: ConnectionSetDefault

ConnectionUpdate.description: Replace environment values, secret values, or the default flag.

env.description: Replaces every plain setting. A value sent exactly as `kitaru_connection_read` shows it, such as `***` or `Bearer ***`, keeps the value the connection stores; leaving a key out deletes it. A key that names a credential is accepted only as `***`: put new credentials in `secrets`.
env.title: Env

expected_updated.description: The connection's `updated` time as `kitaru_connection_read` shows it; required with `env` or `secrets`, and checked on any update that sends it. The server reads the connection just before writing and refuses the update if its `updated` differs, as a change to `env` or `default` makes it. Not detected: a change committed after that read, and a change to secrets alone, which leaves `updated` as it was.
expected_updated.title: Expected Updated

remove_secrets.description: Names of stored secrets this update deletes on purpose; goes with `secrets`. `secrets: {}` with every stored name here deletes them all. A name the connection no longer stores is ignored.
remove_secrets.title: Remove Secrets

secrets.description: Replaces every stored secret. Stored values cannot be read back, so send every secret the connection should keep, not only new ones, and name each stored secret to delete in `remove_secrets`; an update that would drop a stored secret otherwise is refused.
secrets.title: Secrets

ConnectionUpdate.title: ConnectionUpdate
